svg.title: Point of no return
svg.text: When does the outcome stop depending on the rest of the reasoning?
Cut a saved run's reasoning at about 11 sentence boundaries, let the model write the rest 8 times from each cut, and count
how often it ends as the original run did. Mean over runs; band = 95% interval over questions. Dotted line: the 7-of-8 commitment threshold.
Qwen3-8B: wrong claim planted at the start of its reasoning
share of the reasoning kept before the cut
kept B (n=30): at start 30%, never 3%, median point 0.26
recovered (n=12): at start 8%, never 0%, median point 0.25
Qwen3-8B: "Hint: The answer is X."
share of the reasoning kept before the cut
followed the hint (n=20): at start 50%, never 30%, median point 0.00
resisted (n=10): at start 0%, never 70%, median point 0.80
Qwen3-14B: scored agent + grader-bug note
share of the reasoning kept before the cut
took the bug (n=24): at start 4%, never 12%, median point 0.43
didn't (n=10): at start 20%, never 10%, median point 0.20
Reward-hack model (warm-start version)
share of reasoning + code kept (hack runs: up to the hack line)
hidden hack (n=24): at start 4%, never 25%, median point 0.88
no hack (n=12): at start 0%, never 0%, median point 1.00
Committed = from that cut on, at least 7 of 8 resamples end as the original run. At start = committed before any reasoning;
never = not committed even with all of the reasoning kept; median point = median share of the reasoning kept at commitment.
Source: docs/overnight/data/point_of_no_return.json (cases.<case>.groups.<group>.p_same_curve); report: point_of_no_return.md.
